acceptance: zmux is an input following nixpkgs-home, as panopticon does. The overlay reaches system and home evaluations, proved by a factory check. zp joins the terminal feature, without ZP_ROOT. Tracked under that repo's doctrine conventions.
body:
HANDOFF to a ~/flakes agent. Operator-directed, 2026-11-06. ~/flakes' own conventions govern how this lands: read its CLAUDE.md and doctrine boot first. The operator expects a backlog item with an agreed sketch rather than a slice, but that call is theirs and that repo's. zmux needs nothing changed for this task: v0.1.0 is tagged and pushed.

CHANGES
- flake.nix: add input zmux, url github:davidlee/zmux/v0.1.0, inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs-home". Its only inputs are nixpkgs, flake-parts and devshell; it no longer carries agents or quotient, so panopticon's agents.follows does not apply.
- hosts.nix: add inputs.zmux.overlays.default to homeModule's nixpkgs.overlays (every home, darwin included) and to the system evaluations through platformModule (NixOS and darwin). hosts/Sleipnir/config.nix also sets nixpkgs.overlays, so check the two merge.
- hosts.nix factoryChecks: test first. Add a check that fails unless pkgs.zmx is the wrapper in a home and in a system evaluation; pkgs ? zmx-unwrapped is a sufficient probe.
- features/terminal.nix, `utils` feature: add zp beside zmx. Do NOT set ZP_ROOT: see d-picker-jobs.

NO CHANGE NEEDED
The zmx lines in features/terminal.nix and features/editor/emacs.nix already name pkgs.zmx, so the overlay reaches them.

FACTS
- The repo went public on 2026-11-06. github:davidlee/zmux/v0.1.0 builds with store paths identical to the local tree.
- pkgs.zmx is the wrapper, pkgs.zmx-unwrapped the real binary, pkgs.zp the picker. On aarch64-darwin zp evaluates as available; it has not been built there.

RISKS
- Switching changes what every new `zmx` call runs. Running sessions are unaffected. Activation is the operator's act.
- Other sessions may be working in the tree, and the worktree is $HOME. Stage by explicit path.
- flake.lock: the operator permits committing it whole, including the pending emacs-overlay bump.

COME BACK WITH
The commit, the evaluation evidence, and the result of the root fetch. Record status here.
notes:
2026-11-06: repo public, so the input is github:davidlee/zmux/v0.1.0; the earlier git+ssh note is superseded. In progress in ~/flakes as flakes:IMP-067.
2026-11-06: landed in ~/flakes as b43b7562, tracked by flakes:IMP-067. just gate and just coverage pass, isolation included; the factory check was seen red first. pkgs.zmx and pkgs.zp build on x86_64-linux. Root fetch: moot now the repo is public. Not done: activation (operator), and a zp build on aarch64-darwin. Kept out of bin/dev-checkouts, since just isolation stubs those inputs.
